verses.1: A song of ascents. Happy are all who fear the LORD, those who walk in his ways.
verses.2: You shall eat the fruit of your labor; you shall be happy and fare well.
verses.3: Your wife will be like a flourishing vine in the courtyards of your home; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
verses.4: Indeed, this is how the man who fears the LORD will be blessed.
verses.5: May the LORD bless you from Zion; may you see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.6: And may you see children of your children — peace upon Israel.

notes:
Notes
- v. 2: "the fruit of your labor" is a contextual rendering of *kaprekh yadekha*, which literally means "the fruit of your hands."
raw:
[1] A song of ascents. Happy are all who fear the LORD, those who walk in his ways.

[2] You shall eat the fruit of your labor; you shall be happy and fare well.

[3] Your wife will be like a flourishing vine in the courtyards of your home; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.

[4] Indeed, this is how the man who fears the LORD will be blessed.

[5] May the LORD bless you from Zion; may you see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

[6] And may you see children of your children — peace upon Israel.

Notes
- v. 2: "the fruit of your labor" is a contextual rendering of *kaprekh yadekha*, which literally means "the fruit of your hands."
